info.title: HNN Biller — Complete API
info.description:
Every endpoint across all feature groups.

### Editions
Every client runs on one of two editions in the **same deployment**:

| Edition | Includes |
|---|---|
| `non_commercial` | Billing, payer routing, patient payments, dashboard, notifications, medical reports |
| `commercial` | Everything above **plus** revenue rules & other charges, financing, NHIS ClaimIt tracker, agnostic payer tabs, audit ledger |

Switching is a per-client flag flip — no redeploy, no data migration, and **nothing is deleted on downgrade**.
Commercial-only endpoints return **402 `upgrade_required`** when the caller's client is non-commercial.
Check your own entitlement any time with `GET /api/v1/bills/edition`.

**Base URL:** `https://nextgenhnnbiller-production.up.railway.app`

post.summary: Create an itemised bill

items.description: REQUIRED. At least one line item.

code.description: Catalogue code (e.g. GP-CONSULT). Optional if name+cost given.

qty.description: Quantity (default 1). Line total = cost x qty.

nhisTariffCode.description: Optional NHIS tariff code passed through to the claim.

copayPercent.description: Patient share of net (0 = payers cover all). Explicit — no implicit default.

insurance.description: Optional at bill creation; memberId REQUIRED only when routing to a payer.

clinical.description: OPTIONAL clinical context carried onto the claim (insurers often require it). Never required to bill.

icdCode.description: ICD-10 or ICD-11 code, e.g. B54 / 1F40

split.description: OPTIONAL. Split the covered (payer) portion between two or more payers. Omit for a single payer. Each payer gets its own itemised claim; the claims sum exactly to the payer share.

percent.description: Share as % of the payer portion (use percent OR amount)

amount.description: Explicit GHS share (amounts must sum to the payer portion)

paying.description: Set false to exclude a listed payer (checkbox off)

201.description: Bill with computed totals (subtotal, discount, net, payerShare, cashback, patientPayable)

201.description: Single: { claim, payerLink, mode:"single" }. Split: { claims:[{claimId,payerId,payerName,amount,payerLink}], split, mode:"split" }.

get.summary: Rule types, modes, caps, allowed charge targets
get.description: Drive your own configuration UI from this — caps and targets are authoritative and enforced server-side.

put.description:
Percentage rules: `expedited_settlement` (cap 15%), `discount_fee` (cap 15%), `claimit_margin` (cap 100% of cashback) — send `rate` (0–1 or 0–100; clamped to the cap).

Flat "other charges": `report_fee_mini`, `report_fee_standard` — send `amount` in GHS.

put.summary: Toggle whether a payer’s price list governs settlement (default off)
put.description: When enabled, claims routed to this payer are repriced to its approved prices (facility-specific first, then default, else the billed price). The patient absorbs any gap between billed and approved. Default off = the list is reference-only and the billed price governs.
